notes: No public Gautam Budh Nagar-specific absconder / proclaimed-offender list found as of 2026-05. UP Police does run a state-level 'Most Wanted' page with ~33 entries (photo, name, father's name, address, reward) at https://uppolice.gov.in/en/MostWanted, but it has no district filter and a manual scan of addresses showed zero entries from Gautam Budh Nagar / Noida / Greater Noida (closest is one Ghaziabad entry). GBN Police circulates wanted-criminal lists via press releases and Twitter (@noidapolice) but does not publish a stable machine-readable absconder file. Sources checked: (1) https://uppolice.gov.in/en/MostWanted - state-level only, no Noida entries. (2) https://uppolice.gov.in/article/en/crime - 'Heinous Crime Monitoring System Most Wanted/Missing Person' widget, links back to the same state-level list. (3) https://gbnagar.nic.in/police/ - district police page lists only the 26 police stations with SHO contacts, no absconder roster. (4) https://uppolice.gov.in/frmOfficials.aspx?cd=NAA0ADYAMwA%3D (Police Commissionerate G.B. Nagar) - officer roster only. (5) noidapolice.com / .in - vehicle and police-verification forms only. (6) UP Police press-release archive search returned generic GBN press releases, no stable absconder PDF.
